tagline: AI Crop Disease Detection & Outbreak Risk System

hero.badge: AI Computer Vision + Environmental Weather Telemetry
hero.title: Protect Your Harvest with AI Disease Detection & Outbreak Risk Intelligence
hero.subtitle: Upload a leaf photo from your field. Get instant computer-vision diagnostic identification, local environmental outbreak risk prediction, and safe extension-verified treatment guidance.
hero.how_subtitle: A 100% software-based agronomic decision support system requiring no expensive hardware sensors.
hero.step1_desc: Take a photo of any damaged or suspicious crop foliage using your smartphone or tablet camera. The system strips EXIF metadata for total privacy.
hero.step2_desc: Open-Meteo telemetry syncs historical humidity, leaf wetness hours, and 7-day temperature forecasts to compute a transparent 0-100 outbreak risk score.
hero.step3_desc: Receive actionable, organic-first treatment steps, chemical protectant dosage calculations, and pesticide safety warnings in your local language.

analyze.title: Analyze Crop Leaf
analyze.upload_instruction: Take a clear, well-lit photo of the affected leaf
analyze.drag_drop: or drag and drop leaf photo here
analyze.tip_1: Focus on a single leaf showing visible spots or lesions
analyze.tip_2: Ensure natural, bright sunlight without deep shadows
analyze.tip_3: Avoid blurry hands or extremely distant shots
analyze.analyzing: Analyzing leaf image and calculating environmental risk...

result.uncertain_desc: The model confidence is below the diagnostic threshold or leaf features are ambiguous. Please consult your local agricultural extension officer or call the Kisan Call Center (1800-180-1551).
result.risk_advisory: Advisory estimate based on agronomic thresholds; not a laboratory forecast.
result.calc_subtitle: Precise water & medicine measurement for Indian 10L / 15L / 16L spray pumps
result.calc_mixing_guide: Field Mixing Instructions (No Clumps / No Clogging)
result.calc_morning_badge: Best Time: Early morning (6:30–9:00 AM) or late evening (4:30–6:30 PM).
result.calc_wind_badge: Wind Safety: Always spray with the wind at your back, never into the wind.
result.calc_healthy_notice: Your crop is healthy. Chemical or bio-fungicide sprays are not recommended.
